Wonder how cognitive health is evaluated in Riyadh?

The assessment spans 2‑3 days as an outpatient pathway.
It includes specialist neurology, behavioral neurology, or geriatric medicine consultation.
Structured cognitive screening, mental status exam and formal psychometric testing are provided.
A baseline brain MRI or structural neuroimaging scan is part of the package.

Read the full guide:
